## Result
- Skill: design-review
- Review status: changes-requested
- Package members: CLI owning amendment; unchanged Record Format interaction; complete linked CLI request/receipt and observation examples and Record Format manifest/reassessment examples, each selected in subjects.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review-r1
- Review ID and round: design-review-r1, round 1
- Material findings: readable-text-contract
- Correction targets: cli, design author
- Recording status: recorded
- Open blockers: none
- Immediate next stage: route to design owner
- Claim limitations: no Design approval, delivery authority, implementation correctness or final verification. The existing candidate predates this assessment.

The new-file and targeted-edit encoding contract is coherent with RF-SR-01/03/04/08: same closed JSON objects and escaped stored bodies, no migration, unchanged neighbor bytes, exact-byte advanced publication/recovery, retained compact hash/cursor encodings and indentation charged against limits. Existing examples remain semantic illustrations, not canonical printer snapshots; their identities and illustrated origin/freshness invariants remain applicable. Required compatibility and failure boundaries are available for Delivery derivation.

The approved terminal-readability goal has no discriminating owning requirement. CLI-SR-11 and current text paragraphs require preserved meaning/scope but allow the old escaped JSON presentation. The only amendment governs persisted file encoding. Design must make decoded multiline human display and literal escape preservation explicit before Delivery can derive its acceptance oracle. This is a bounded artifact-local correction, not a proposal reconsideration.

## Material finding
Finding ID: readable-text-contract
Severity: medium
Location: docs/design/cli/cli.md, Primary result schema and Boundary scan sections
Evidence: proposal Goals selects actual line breaks and intentional escape preservation; CLI-SR-11 and current text clauses only require same information/meaning and the amendment at Lossless candidate construction addresses stored files.
Required outcome: state the primary human-rendering contract and a representative scenario distinguishing decoded newlines from literal backslash-n while preserving complete scope and existing byte-budget/failure rules.
Safe resolution path: design author adds a bounded CLI paragraph and acceptance scenario; independent reviewer reassesses the revised exact package.
Finding scope: artifact-local
Affected artifact IDs: cli
Owning stages: design

findings.evidence: Severity medium; artifact-local cli/design. Old escaped JSON text would still satisfy these clauses.

resolution.rationale: Independently inspected CLI sha256:81415e142116d43f5428e549f714a0e9a8ba06adafb50371e580ac6172f00792. Required Design outcome is satisfied; this is contract inspection evidence, not an implementation test claim.
